notes: Imd6900 is a fee-free ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender. It exposes no additional minting, burning or administrative controls. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool fee is 0.3%; token transfers have no fee. initialPrice is a provenance reference equal to floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), treating IMD6900 as currency0 and the paired token as currency1. The deployer derives the opening price from the supplied economics and totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
